title: Contract Portfolio Consolidation — Q4 2026
summary: Working consolidation sheet for high-priority contracts due in Q4 2026. Purpose: single-pane tracker combining contract dates, ARR, probability, suggested playbook steps, escalation paths, and a lightweight priority heatmap column to drive weekly CS tactical reviews. This is an in-progress artifact intended for the renewal ops cadence — expect incomplete fields and live updates.
version_notes: v0.3 — added executive sponsor column, converted ARR to normalized monthly where possible, introduced 'PriorityScore' = ARR * Probability factor for quick sorting. Marked rows needing legal review. (Maya, 2026-11-12)
